title: Crazy Food Truck
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a post-apocalyptic desert, Gordon, a gruff ex-soldier, runs a food truck. He picks up Arisa, a mysterious naked girl he finds asleep in the road, and the two flee the military forces hunting her while cooking burgers, hunting giant squid and freeing a beer-brewing town from bandits. Hints of their pasts build toward later twists over three volumes.
life_message: Good food, loyalty and freedom from armed control are worth fighting for even in a ruined world.

content.note: ANN calls the action viscerally violent with gunplay, martial arts and a giant cannon; MangaUpdates Blood and Gore, Violence, Murder; AniList Guns, Military.
Arisa 'cannot keep her clothes on' as fanservice (ANN); a critic calls fanservice excessive (Wikipedia); AniList Nudity 67% and Ecchi genre; MangaUpdates Nudity, Mature. No sex reported.

folkways.japan: Uses the Japanese gourmet-manga habit of building each chapter around a dish, set in a non-Japanese desert world.

delivery.note: An action-food road story; the military pursuers are obstacles rather than spokesmen for a view in the sources opened.

winners_losers: Gordon and Arisa outfight bandits and soldiers; militarized power and bandits lose; sympathy goes to the fugitives and the towns they help.
